title: DNS as a side channel
objective: Resolve an allowlisted name, then resolve a unique subdomain of an owned zone and check whether the query reached our DNS logger.
limitation: The canary is configured as the sandbox upstream resolver to model a provider resolver that forwards to the internet. Zero queries shows this resolver path did not forward the label; other resolvers or DNS-over-HTTPS are not covered.

argv:
import json, socket
try:
    socket.getaddrinfo('<<allowed_host>>', 8080)
    resolved = True
except Exception:
    resolved = False
print(json.dumps({'resolved': resolved}))

import json, socket
try:
    socket.getaddrinfo('<<exfil_name>>', 80)
    resolved = True
except Exception:
    resolved = False
print(json.dumps({'resolved': resolved}))
